controls.title: Single agent trust root and instruction surface
controls.requirement: AGENTS.md is the only repository-wide AI-agent trust root and instruction surface. Repository-level provider instruction mirrors such as CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md remain absent.

controls.title: Agent capability plane is subordinate to repository governance
controls.requirement: ESS-0019 defines provider-neutral capability, risk, audit and execution-plane contracts; it is not a second repository trust root and cannot supersede AGENTS.md or manufacture Human/Owner authority.

controls.title: Stable authority identity
controls.requirement: Every new normative governance artifact has one immutable AUTH-* identity independent of path or display number.

controls.title: Deterministic supersession and suspension
controls.requirement: Recency only orders versions of the same stable authority identity; cross-authority replacement requires an explicit scope/supersedes relationship and Owner-visible impact analysis. Suspended artifacts remain traceable but non-authorizing.

controls.title: Unique active ADR and ESS namespaces
controls.requirement: No two active ADR or ESS artifacts may expose the same canonical display ID. ADR display IDs are reserved in docs/adr/registry.json before creation; active reservations are deterministic registry state and are converted or released after merge/close. Historical aliases remain explicit and non-authorizing.

controls.title: New or touched ADR registration
controls.requirement: Every new or materially migrated ADR is registered with stable authorityId, unique active displayId, version, date, lifecycle and supersession/alias metadata before merge-readiness.

controls.title: Deterministic ADR namespace reservation
controls.requirement: Before a new ADR is created its display ID is reserved in the existing ADR registry with displayId, branch, source, path, observedHead, state and reservedAt. Duplicate active reservations, an active record plus active reservation, malformed/stale reservations or unresolved reservation lifecycle are fail-closed. CI evaluates registry state only; live GitHub correlation is a separate preflight.

controls.title: Canonical document placement and lifecycle
controls.requirement: New governance, architecture, compliance, runbook, roadmap and evidence documents use their canonical docs domain and required lifecycle metadata; repository root Markdown is restricted to README.md and AGENTS.md; suspended artifacts live only in designated lifecycle/archive locations.

controls.title: Document roles and projection boundaries
controls.requirement: Registered document roles are explicit and machine-readable. Inventory and roadmap artifacts are non-normative; projections reference known active authorities; FRONTEND_ARCH is normative only for frontend-source-tree, frontend-dependencies and presentation-architecture and may not claim financial-runtime, market-data, scoring, ranking, financial-eligibility or runtime-evidence scope.

controls.title: Documentation hygiene is a reusable read-only service
controls.requirement: Documentation hygiene executes through src/platform/Documentary/Governance/Services/DocumentationHygieneValidator.ts and its CLI. It validates repository/document-registry structure read-only and does not become repository-wide authorization authority.

controls.title: Single platform-version authority and projections
controls.requirement: package.json#version is the sole platform-version authority. README and runtime/admin API values are deterministic/read-only projections. AGENTS.md Control Plane Version is independent governance metadata. uploads/version_manager.json, the legacy bump endpoint and automatic VersionManager ADR/compliance/document generation are non-authorizing and may not mutate current platform version or documentation.

controls.title: Historical evidence is retained but non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Suspended/superseded/historical decisions, historical runbooks, evidence and reports remain traceable and may not silently regain current authority through age, location, prior ACCEPTED labels or citation.

controls.title: Governance integrity before feature readiness
controls.requirement: A feature may not become merge-ready while a correlated critical governance identity, authority or control-plane conflict remains unresolved.

controls.title: Fresh scoped and project-identifiable branch
controls.requirement: Repository changes are made only on a fresh scoped branch from current main; direct main edits are prohibited. Every new agent-managed work branch uses a permitted execution-prefix and the form <approved-agent-prefix>/<project-folder>-<compact-task>-<YYYYMMDD>, where project-folder is the canonical Primary-Owner project slug and compact-task is lowercase kebab-case identifying the bounded work item. Historical/merged/terminal branches are not renamed retroactively. A newly created non-conforming branch must be replaced by a fresh current-main conforming branch before protected work or PR readiness proceeds; branch naming never changes project ownership, Authority, merge authority or production permissions.

controls.title: Final main synchronization
controls.requirement: Immediately before requesting PR-creation approval, refresh main, correlate newly merged changes and open PR writers, synchronize the branch, resolve overlap and repeat necessary low-cost checks on the exact candidate snapshot.

controls.title: Explicit Owner approval before Pull Request creation
controls.requirement: A Pull Request or Draft Pull Request may be created only after final current-main synchronization/correlation and explicit Human/Owner approval bound to the reported main SHA and candidate head SHA. Any main or head change before creation invalidates the approval and requires repeated correlation, synchronization, validation as needed and renewed approval. PR-creation approval does not authorize merge. During a valid active ADR-0104 v1.2 PT8H session, the repeated per-PR Human approval requirement is temporarily replaced only for Human-directed work attributable to the session's exact bound chat and exactly one predeclared canonical project/project folder. Immediate pre-create main/head/open-writer/project-owner correlation remains mandatory; foreign-project paths, chat transfer, project transfer, SHA drift or ownership ambiguity fail closed. ADR-0104 standing PR-creation authorization never authorizes merge.

controls.title: Chat handoff: bounded post-PR continuation and foreign-project routing
controls.requirement: This stable control has two explicit triggers. POST_PR_HANDOFF preserves the existing bounded post-PR behavior: after every chat-governed PR or Draft PR, report the correlated main/head and known gate state, display at most the two highest-priority immediately actionable next steps, name exit gates, and recompute current main/open-PR correlation after a displayed step completes. FOREIGN_PROJECT_HANDOFF applies whenever the next required productive step belongs to another canonical project or Primary Owner: stop local foreign implementation, resolve and visibly report target project, canonical target folder, affected VC/PVC and Primary Owner, emit [CROSS_PROJECT_HANDOFF -> <TARGET_PROJECT> | VC-<NN>], set REFERRED_NOT_EXECUTED, and immediately generate a complete copyable target-project prompt. Generated prompts contain the required fresh-precheck/correlation/scope/tests/validation/PR/Human-Merge context and are automatically split only when necessary into parts of at most 400 lines; unresolved target owner or folder is REQUIRES_CORRELATION. ADR-0104 v1.2 does not supersede FOREIGN_PROJECT_HANDOFF: every ADR-0104 activation is bound to one project, and work owned by another project must use this baseline handoff path. Moving to another project requires a separate valid activation in a separate exact chat if an unused ADR-0104 activation ordinal remains.

controls.title: Timeboxed Human Owner delegated execution session
controls.requirement: ADR-0104 v1.2 is authorizing only after Human Merge of the amendment and only for a successfully activated session. Each activation is bound to exactly one chat and exactly one canonical project/project folder for PT8H, cannot be transferred or repointed, and permits no foreign-project implementation. The stable authority permits at most three successful lifetime activations ADR-0104-S1 through S3; PR #678 counts as S1, expired/revoked successful sessions remain consumed, invalid attempts do not consume an ordinal, and no S4 is authorized without a new explicit Human Owner authority change. Within the bound project a valid session may replace repeated PR/Draft-PR creation and eligible protected repository/connected-provider/production mutation approval prompts, but Pull Request merge execution is never delegated: every Pull Request must be merged through a distinct Human Owner action. Every action still preserves current-main/open-writer/project-owner/target correlation, hosted technical gates, provider authentication/capability constraints, secret protection, fail-closed security ambiguity, external law/contracts, truthful evidence and required independent assurance. Human Merge of v1.2 terminates any remaining unbound v1.1 delegated authority and any prior v1.1 merge-delegation effect without inferring a project binding.

controls.title: Pre-PR evidence is non-authorizing
controls.requirement: Local or sandbox build/test evidence must be bound to the exact candidate SHA and never creates Human authority by itself. During a valid ADR-0104 session, authorization comes from the active chat/project-bound Human Owner delegation, not from test evidence.

controls.title: Independent hosted technical validation
controls.requirement: GitHub hosted build-and-test remains the independent technical check for the final PR head before merge when applicable to the PR check class, including Pull Requests created under a valid project-bound ADR-0104 delegated session. Successful hosted checks establish technical evidence only; the Human Owner still performs every Pull Request merge.

controls.title: M10 passkey gate remains suspended
controls.requirement: M10 AUTHORIZE_PR_CI remains suspended/off under baseline policy. Reactivation requires no duplicate or ambiguous ADR/ESS/Authority references; an explicit non-overlapping responsibility model between src/platform/Governance and src/platform/Documentary/Governance; reconciled README version projection/documentary Hygiene and Version Manager/Release Version contracts with one source of truth; reconciled router-related governance/version references; structural governance validation and independent hosted CI on the exact final head; and a new explicit Human/Owner decision. Historical M10 evidence cannot reactivate the gate. An in-scope Human-directed ADR-0104 session work item may change this architecture only if all then-current technical/governance prerequisites and provider capabilities are satisfied; ADR-0104 standing authorization replaces repeated Owner approval but does not manufacture missing prerequisites or validation evidence.

controls.title: Human Owner-only Pull Request merge boundary
controls.requirement: Every Pull Request MUST be merged by the Human Owner through a distinct Human Owner merge action. Agent/chat self-merge, delegated merge execution, auto-merge enablement, or any equivalent mechanism that causes merge without that distinct Human Owner action is prohibited. Green CI, reviews, labels, reactions, comments, elapsed time, PR metadata and an active ADR-0104 session never constitute merge authority. ADR-0104 v1.2 explicitly preserves this control for amendment PRs, ordinary in-project PRs, governance PRs and rollback PRs alike.

controls.title: Single verified production deployment authority
controls.requirement: Render native auto-deploy remains off; production promotion occurs through verified main CI, supply-chain attestation, exact-SHA deploy hook and post-deployment identity verification. A valid ADR-0104 v1.2 session may delegate execution of this existing path only for targets attributable to its bound project; it does not create a second deployment authority, authorize foreign-project targets or manufacture missing technical prerequisites.

controls.title: Reusable secrets stay outside evidence and model output
controls.requirement: Secrets, reusable credentials, private passkey material and raw sensitive tokens must not be committed or reproduced in model-visible evidence. ADR-0104 delegates mutations, not secret exfiltration or disclosure.

controls.title: Least privilege and fail-closed security ambiguity
controls.requirement: Protected workflows and external mutations preserve least privilege and fail closed on unresolved security-critical ambiguity. Runtime compatibility guards may deny retired writes but may not bypass normal AuthN/AuthZ for authenticated read endpoints. Under ADR-0104 v1.2, standing Human authorization removes repeated approval prompts only inside one exact chat and one bound project; it does not remove target/project-owner verification, risk-proportionate rollback/restore planning, provider authentication, foreign-project routing, the three-activation lifetime quota, Human Owner-only Pull Request merge or fail-closed ambiguity handling.

controls.title: Governance continual improvement
controls.requirement: Governance controls are planned, implemented, evaluated and improved with dated evidence and explicit change ownership; external standards are mapped through a non-authorizing crosswalk rather than imported as a competing policy hierarchy.

controls.title: No unsupported certification or regulatory-status claims
controls.requirement: Engineering alignment to ISO/NIST or repository controls does not establish certification, regulated-entity status, high-risk AI classification or complete legal compliance without independent scope/evidence.
